jobs.title: Marketplace Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Who we are: 
Nitra's mission is to build a more efficient healthcare system and the technology that makes it possible.  Our goal is to provide an ecosystem of fintech and software solutions that help doctors better manage their practices, so they can have time back to focus on what matters to them most.
 
We operate with urgency, intensity, and ambition. The bar is high because the opportunity is massive. We expect excellence, ownership, and intellectual rigor from every team member. We move fast, make bold decisions, and hold ourselves accountable to results. At the same time, we believe great companies are built on trust and respect. Every voice matters. Every contribution counts. When we win, we win together.
 
We are scaling rapidly and on a clear trajectory toward becoming a unicorn this year — and beyond. Our growth is not accidental; it’s the result of disciplined execution, relentless focus, and a team that refuses to settle. We are building a category-defining company, and we’re looking for people who want to do the most meaningful work of their careers.
 
If you want comfort, this isn’t the place.
If you want impact, ownership, and the chance to help build a generational fintech company, welcome.
 
Nitra was created by unicorn founders who have successfully scaled to thousands of customers and exited $1B+ public offerings. They are joined by an ambitious and experienced team from American Express, Citi, PayPal, Capsule, Plaid, Bloomberg, Meta, Facebook, and Mastercard. The team is backed by some of the world’s leading VCs (Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, etc.) and is supported by an expert group of advisors including the cofounders of Square and Xendit, executives from Intuit, former Governors, White House senior staffers, and a co-founder of CityMD.

We're looking for:
You would be joining Nitra at a critical stage of growth as we scale through Series B and build the foundation for the next phase of the company.

We’re looking for a Marketplace Operations Lead to help build and scale the operating engine behind NitraMart, Nitra’s healthcare marketplace . This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, has exceptional attention to detail, and enjoys solving complex operational problems.

You will work cross-functionally to manage day-to-day marketplace operations, resolve issues across the customer and order journey, improve workflows, and use data to identify opportunities to make NitraMart more efficient and reliable. Your work will help build the processes and systems needed to scale the marketplace to thousands of healthcare practices.

The ideal candidate brings 4-8 years of experience in marketplace, business, e-commerce, logistics, or customer operations, ideally at a high-growth technology company. Experience with order flows, vendors, product catalogs, fulfillment, or procurement is a strong plus.

You are proactive, analytical, highly organized, and comfortable operating through ambiguity. You take ownership, move quickly from identifying problems to resolving them, and know when to solve something manually versus building a more scalable solution.
Your responsibilities will include:
- Own day-to-day NitraMart operations

- Manage marketplace workflows across orders, vendors, products, fulfillment, and customer issues.

- Identify operational problems and drive them through resolution quickly and accurately.

- Deliver a great marketplace experience

- Partner with Customer Success, Product, and other teams to improve the end-to-end customer journey.

- Monitor marketplace performance and identify opportunities to improve utilization, reliability, and customer satisfaction.

- Turn data into action

- Track marketplace KPIs, investigate trends and root causes, and translate insights into clear actions.

- Build reporting and analyses that improve visibility into marketplace performance.

- Build scalable processes

- Improve workflows, documentation, reporting, and internal tools as NitraMart grows.

- Identify repetitive manual work and partner with Product and Engineering on opportunities for automation.

- Support marketplace growth

- Help launch new vendors, products, and marketplace capabilities.

- Work cross-functionally to execute initiatives that expand and improve NitraMart
You have:
- 4-8 years of experience in marketplace operations, business operations, e-commerce, logistics, customer operations, or a similarly operational role.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with comfort working with data and spreadsheets; SQL experience is a plus.

- Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple operational workstreams.

- High ownership, urgency, and comfort operating in a fast-moving startup environment.

- A builder mindset—you identify problems, develop practical solutions, and drive them through completion.

- Strong communication skills and experience working cross-functionally.

- Experience with B2B marketplaces, e-commerce, procurement, vendors, fulfillment, healthcare, or SMB customers is a plus.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
We offer:
- Equity - Everyone at Nitra is an owner. When the company wins, you win

- Competitive Salary - You’re the best of the best, and your salary will reflect your experience and reward your contributions to Nitra

- Health Care - Your health comes first. We offer comprehensive health, vision, and dental insurance options.

- Retirement Benefits - Your financial stability matters to us so we provide a generous employer 401K match

- Nitra maintains a hybrid work policy, with team members working from the office four days per week and Wednesdays designated as a work-from-home day.
Nitra values diversity. We are committed to equal opportunities and creating an inclusive environment for all our employees. We welcome applicants regardless of ethnicity, national origin or ancestry, gender, race, religious beliefs, disability, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, genetic information, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We are looking for a highly entrepreneurial and customer-obsessed Customer & Community Growth Manager to build and scale the engagement engine behind Nitra's customer ecosystem. As we continue to scale through Series B, we're building more than software—we're creating the largest community of independent healthcare practice owners in the country. You'll be responsible for launching customer communities, developing advocacy programs, leading customer communications, and creating educational content that strengthens relationships while driving measurable business growth.
The ideal candidate is a builder who thrives in high-growth startups and enjoys creating programs from scratch. You'll be equally comfortable speaking with physicians, practice administrators, executives, and cross-functional stakeholders while turning customer engagement into increased product adoption, higher spend, stronger retention, and long-term loyalty.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Build and scale customer communities across Nitra's healthcare customer base through specialty-specific (Dermatology, Ophthalmology, Dental, etc.) and role-specific communities for physicians, office managers, and practice administrators.

- Launch and manage online communities, customer forums, networking groups, regional chapters, customer councils, summits, and exclusive events that strengthen relationships with Nitra customers.

- Develop customer growth initiatives that increase adoption and cross-product usage across Nitra's fintech, marketplace, and AI software offerings.

- Own customer advocacy programs including customer ambassadors, physician affiliates, referral programs, testimonials, case studies, customer stories, and reference programs.

- Lead customer communications including newsletters, lifecycle campaigns, product announcements, educational content, webinars, and customer onboarding initiatives.

- Create thought leadership content including physician podcasts, benchmark reports, industry research, customer surveys, and practice management insights.

- Build and manage Customer Advisory Boards and Physician Councils to strengthen relationships, gather product feedback, and influence future product strategy.

- Partner closely with Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, and Sales to deliver exceptional customer experiences across the full customer lifecycle.

- Measure customer engagement and optimize programs based on data, continuously improving participation, advocacy, product adoption, and expansion.

- Analyze customer behavior and develop scalable engagement strategies that increase retention, referrals, customer satisfaction, and revenue growth.
You have:
- 5+ years of experience in Customer Marketing, Community, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Partnerships, Growth, or similar customer-facing roles.

- Experience building customer communities, advocacy programs, or engagement initiatives from the ground up.

- Strong understanding of customer lifecycle marketing, customer engagement, retention, and expansion strategies.

- Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and executive presence with the ability to influence customers and internal stakeholders without direct authority.

- Excellent project management and cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to execute multiple initiatives simultaneously.

- Strong analytical mindset with experience measuring customer engagement and business outcomes.

- Comfortable operating in ambiguity and moving quickly from idea to execution.

- Experience supporting SMB and mid-market customers.

- Experience in healthcare, fintech, SaaS, marketplaces, or vertical software is a strong plus.

- Experience working in VC-backed Series B-D technology companies is strongly preferred.

- Coach and support hiring managers and people leaders on interviewing, feedback, performance conversations, and team development

- Own foundational people infrastructure, including job leveling, documentation, policies, and tooling as the company scales

- Serve as a steward of company culture and values, ensuring they are reflected in how we hire, develop, and retain talent

- 8+ years of experience in People Operations, Talent, or HR, including experience operating at a Director or equivalent senior level

- Experience scaling small companies to mid-sized organizations in a short timespan across multiple geographies, offices, and countries (e.g., 50 to 300 people)

- Proven experience partnering with executives and senior leaders in a fast-growing startup or scale-up environment

- Ability to maintain a high velocity, fast-paced culture across departments through major growth milestones

- Experience managing complex compensation plans across different types of functions

- Strong judgment and ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution when needed

- Deep experience building and scaling recruiting and people systems from early-stage to growth-stage

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across all levels of the organization
